'''Clan Jeban''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Members of Clan Jeban could be identified by a shared red [[Color/Legends|color]]-scheme on their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], and a clan sigil designed around a black [[Sword/Legends|saber]] etched on the wearer's chest plate.<ref name="APM" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], thirteen-year-old [[Dinua Jeban]] completed her ''[[verd'goten]]'', the traditional rite of passage marking a [[Youngling/Legends|youth's]] reaching of adulthood in Mandalorian society. However, with her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Death/Legends|dead]], Dinua was left to travel with her mother, [[Briika Jeban]], in order to find [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work to support themselves. The two met fellow Mandalorian [[Goran Beviin]] in the [[Bar Jaraniz]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and they became good friends over a series of jobs the Mandalorians were hired to perform for the mysterious individual known as Udelen—in actuality, the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], [[Nom Anor]]. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] appeared before the Mandalorians at a staging area in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], a fearful Briika asked Beviin to take in Dinua if anything should happen to her, a request to which Beviin solemnly agreed.<ref name="APM" />

After Anor revealed the Yuuzhan Vong's intentions for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the Mandalorians entered into a false alliance with the Vong: they would officially work for the invaders, while covertly subverting their campaign and gathering intelligence for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While passing information off to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Kubariet]] on [[New Holgha]], the Mandalorians were forced to stall a Yuuzhan Vong [[Subaltern]], [[Bur'lorr]]. During the course of the skirmish with the Vong warrior, Briika was stabbed in the chest by one of the spikes on the warrior's [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|Vonduun armor]]. Despite all efforts to save her, Briika perished due to [[Blood/Legends|blood]] loss. In accordance with her wishes, Dinua was [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] by Beviin, becoming part of [[Clan Beviin|his clan]].<ref name="APM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Jeban first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
